newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rapper Notorious B.I.G. gunned down at party.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rapper Notorious B.I.G. gunned down at party.

text.p: American rapper Notorious B.I.G. was gunned down after he left a party early on Sunday, police said, the second well-known gangsta rap artist slain in six months.

The rapper, whose real name is Christopher Wallace, was leaving a party at the Petersen Automotive Museum just after midnight when multiple rounds of gunfire erupted from a passing vehicle. Police said Wallace, 24, was dead on arrival at a local hospital.
The incident occurred just after officials from the Los Angeles Fire Department closed the private party due to overcrowding.
A police spokesman said investigators did not have any suspects in the shooting.

In September, rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by attack in Las Vegas as he rode in a car with Death Row Records President Marion "Suge" Knight. Shakur died six days later. Police have still not made any arrests in that case.

Wallace, who was considered a rival of Shakur, was honoured as rap artist of the year at the Billboard Awards two years ago. His single, "One More Chance/Stay With Me," was named best rap single in 1995 and his debut album, "Ready to Die", has sold more than one million copies.
